Cic. ND II 156

legūmen, legūminis n.

noun, third declension

any pulse or leguminous plant

Already the Ep. III gloss for cicer.

See also pea, bean, lentil, chickpea, pod.

SourcesLewis & Short: legumen

Theodōrus et pater: Ep. III (cicer in the cēna rūstica, with the gloss legūmen rotundum), Ep. IV (lēns, faba, cicer in the cella penāria), Ep. VII (phasēlī in Baba’s garden).
